HediffDef.label: spirit-wood leg
HediffDef.description:
In the villages under the sect mountains, an old carver of spirit bamboo makes legs for those the beasts have maimed. He soaks the wood for forty nights in spring water touched by a spirit stone, so the grain remembers how to bend like a living knee. It is not a beast's leg, he says, but it will carry you home.

Leg efficiency x0.8. Any healer can fit it; no altar needed.
Celestial dissonance +0.02.

HediffDef.label: spirit-wood arm
HediffDef.description:
The carvers of the outer villages learned their trade mending disciples who lost an arm in their first sword trial. A spirit-wood arm, lashed to the shoulder with qi-soaked cord, is clumsy but honest: it lifts what it is asked to lift and never tires of trying.

Arm efficiency x0.75. Replaces the whole arm, hand included. Any healer can fit it; no altar needed.
Celestial dissonance +0.02.

HediffDef.label: spirit-wood hand
HediffDef.description:
Every novice of the Silent Lotus Temple carves one wooden hand before being taught to heal, and gives it to a stranger. A spirit stone set in the palm lends the wood a sliver of qi: enough to hold a bowl or a hoe, if not a brush.

Hand efficiency x0.8. Replaces only the hand. Any healer can fit it; no altar needed.
Celestial dissonance +0.02.

HediffDef.label: spirit-wood foot
HediffDef.description:
Peddlers on the mountain roads swear the best feet are cut from a tree struck by tribulation lightning, for that wood never rots and never slips. A spirit stone in the heel keeps the grain warm through the winter passes.

Foot efficiency x0.85. Any healer can fit it; no altar needed.
Celestial dissonance +0.02.

HediffDef.label: jade denture
HediffDef.description:
Court physicians of the old dynasties carved dentures from jade offcuts so that toothless lords could still enjoy a banquet. Jade cools the breath, and a jade mouth, the saying goes, never lies — mostly because it never quite closes.

Jaw efficiency x0.9. Any healer can fit it; no altar needed.
Celestial dissonance +0.02.
